title: PROFINET: Update SXP dissection to PN-Spec v2.50
description:
Update the dissection of the Service eXchange Protocol to the current state of the PROFINET specification, specifically IEC CD 61158-6-10 © IEC:2026, Review 20 (advisory board review). Update dissection of PNIO error codes as well. Also includes some improvements for fragmentation handling and shows more info in the columns.

AI-Assisted: yes \[GH Copilot\]

notes.body:
Thanks, will do.

I've done this because the rest of the entries in this field seem to list the response blocks directly after the request blocks as well (e.g. `IODWriteReqHeader` / `IODWriteResHeader` , `ARBlockReq` / `ARBlockRes` , ...).

I've reordered them all in numerical order now as this is less confusing also in my opinion. Also reordered some cases in the switch of `dissect_block` .
